label: FIT-only mechanism/cost validation, no retraining or task selection
hypothesis: The quadratic exact-moment reference may reduce full-step cost at useful dense correspondence settings even against memory-efficient exact BCE/NCE implementations.
motivation: Existing descriptor-only speed and memory probes exclude encoders and use full score matrices for competitors; they cannot establish an application cost advantage.
theory: Unchanged J and bounded cosine critic. All P,Q, crop and normalization definitions inherited from the frozen dense protocol.
controls: All seven arms in each job use identical model weights, crops, descriptors coordinates, device and precision.
BCE/NCE blocked controls compute exactly the same full product/competition objectives, using row-block checkpoint recomputation. No negative sampling approximation.
Fixed original CAL-selected VCS checkpoint for each dataset/seed. Weights do not change; AdamW lr0 includes its computational work.
Rotate arm order deterministically;3warmups+10timed steps per cell; gate1warmup+2timed on1batch.
scope: Zero-grad, encoder forward, interpolation, loss, encoder backward, clipping, zero-lr AdamW; excludes FIT loading/crop generation, CAL/DEV search and checkpoint IO.

numerical_gates.cpu: fp64 blocked/dense values and descriptor gradients at uneven block boundaries;atol1e-12/rtol1e-10
numerical_gates.gpu: both datasets seed1001 all3N: exact/dense VCS and blocked/dense BCE,NCE values atol2e-5+rtol2e-4 and full encoder gradient relative L2<2e-4; finite steps; weight hash unchanged
numerical_gates.admission: Only2GPUgates enter existing pool after CPU PASS. Admit6full probes manually to same pool only after both gates PASS. No new controller.

endpoints: Paired median full-step wall time and peak total/incremental allocated memory for every N/batch/seed.
Compare VCS exact against best measured dense or blocked implementation separately for BCE and NCE; all variants reported.
Combine with all registered dense task results; no task-quality inference from this cost experiment.
success: Cost signal: N2048 exact at least1.2x faster than each competitor best measured implementation, with no higher peak allocation, in at least2of3seeds of EACH dataset using medians across3batches. This is a prospective engineering criterion, not statistical significance. Application advantage additionally requires competitive full dense-series strict AND loose success; no N/metric cherry-pick.
stop: Any equivalence/finiteness/weight-identity failure blocks full probes; retain failure. No chunk-size grid, extra density, retries or additional training automatically. Lack of full-step saving closes this cost claim for the measured operating point.
limitations: No claim that block256 is an optimized global baseline.
Fixed zero-lr steps are not convergence evidence and do not time all training IO.
Shared source models trained with VCS can influence numerical distribution; same across objectives.
No new CAL/DEV numerical evaluation; integrity metadata may reference them. TEST prohibited.
_publication_note: Public scientific protocol excerpt; not an operational freeze, source manifest or admission authorization.
